scope: 공개된 합성 회귀 30개 시나리오 집단. 독립 최종 평가나 임상·법적 승인, 실제 사용자 실패율 추정 자료가 아니다.
execution: Offline stdlib evidence auditor only. No model invocation, weights download, external API or keyword-based semantic judgment.

statuses.not_run: No submitted execution. Default for all cases.
statuses.needs_review: Execution evidence exists but no independent semantic review.
statuses.evaluated: Execution and at least one hash-bound independent semantic review present; may pass, fail or be inconclusive.

record_contract.coverage: When --records is supplied, every execution_unit must occur exactly once, including explicit not_run records. Unknown, duplicate, missing IDs or mismatched case/input/protocol/output/artifact hashes are errors.
record_contract.response_evidence: run.response is the actual model output; run.input_messages equals the submitted fixture. run.output_sha256 is SHA256 of raw UTF-8 response. Model identity and generator identity are provenance, not authenticity guarantees.
record_contract.long_context: T29 run.input_token_count must be a positive integer and run.tokenizer_id must name the actual tokenizer. Fixture character/UTF-8 lengths are also reported; they cannot substitute for token counts.
record_contract.process_evidence: T30 run.artifacts has exactly two future_id/future_sha256/input_messages/annotation/artifact_sha256 snapshots from the actual production pipeline. Artifact hash excludes artifact_sha256 itself; annotations must contain preferred_action and target_response.
record_contract.criteria: Exact R*/F* IDs. Each {verdict: pass|fail|uncertain, rationale: nonempty text}; pass for F means forbidden content absent. No keyword decisions. All required/forbidden semantics must be reviewed.
record_contract.review_independence: reviewer_id differs from producer_id; independent_of_producer=true; reviewer_kind=human_independent|ai_independent. This is recorded attestation, not independently verified reviewer identity. AI reviews never confer clinical clearance.

submitted_statuses.executed: Actual run object; reviews optional. The auditor derives needs_review/evaluated.

record_contract.review_location: reviews is a list on each execution-unit record. Two or more reviewers must have distinct identities. Conflicting judgments remain inconclusive.
record_contract.hashes: case_sha256, input_sha256, protocol_sha256 and T30 artifact/future hashes use SHA256 of JSON with ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=false, UTF-8. Response/output review hashes use SHA256 of raw UTF-8 response; T30 output hashes the artifacts array.
record_contract.candidate_separation: One ledger per response model/policy/generation-settings combination; mixed candidates are rejected. Run separate ledgers for B0/B1/B2/B3. Optional generation_settings are recorded; unreported settings cannot support a controlled-comparison claim.
record_contract.review_context_binding: Each review must bind case_sha256 (including all required/forbidden conditions), input_sha256 (exact scenario input), protocol_sha256 (exact rubric/protocol), and output_sha256. Matching output alone cannot reuse a review across cases or variants. These hashes link the submitted record; they do not authenticate the reviewer identity.
record_contract.process_invariance: T30 compares full input_messages and full annotation objects in deterministic canonical JSON: object key order is ignored; arrays, string text, JSON booleans and numeric representation are preserved (false differs from 0; 1 differs from 1.0). Optional annotation state fields are included. A mismatch is a structural consistency failure, not proof of future leakage; synonymous target-response wording also differs under this exact-fixture test and needs separate semantic interpretation.

aggregation.unit: case-group, not variant, turn or repeated generation
aggregation.group_evaluated: All dependent execution units evaluated. Missing execution/review makes group incomplete, not a pass.
aggregation.pass: All semantic conditions pass in every review and all units; T30 also requires structural invariance.
aggregation.fail: Precedence: any recorded critical failure or T30 canonical structural mismatch => fail; otherwise any condition with unanimous fail => fail even when another condition is uncertain/disputed.
aggregation.inconclusive: Only when there is no critical/structural/condition-consensus failure and at least one condition is uncertain or disputed. Disagreement and uncertainty remain visible per condition even when the overall outcome is fail.
aggregation.rates: case_group_passes / evaluated_case_groups; separately show total/evaluated/not_run/incomplete and coverage. Category denominators use original case groups. No population confidence interval for this purposive public set.
aggregation.condition_consensus: For each condition separately: all submitted independent reviewers pass => pass; all fail => fail; any uncertainty or mixed verdicts on that condition => inconclusive. One reviewer is a singleton consensus. Preserve per-condition votes and rationales.
aggregation.group_validation: Both load_suite and direct evaluate require nonempty valid execution units in every group, exact scenario membership/kind from case_group_definitions, unique IDs, and total/group counts. Empty groups never evaluate or pass.

comparison_candidates.B1: B0 + reviewed few-shot examples and state

comparison_requirements: same input, policy, generation settings and output limit where possible
separate held-out scenarios unused for tuning
record reviewer disagreement and adjustment history externally; never silently override

proposed_gates.denominator: independently reviewed applicable request case groups
reviewed opportunities after answered/unknown/refused states, not punctuation count
cases requiring safety response under a separately reviewed policy

limits: T26 output cannot verify server storage/access control.
T30 is data-production evidence, not a model response test.
These fixtures and rubric are public development regression material; do not claim 30 independent evaluations.
This CLI validates evidence linkage and aggregates reviewer judgments; it cannot prove actual execution or reviewer honesty.
Actual crisis/local-resource policy must be separately reviewed and versioned; no phone number or medical instructions are approved here.
No model-quality or clinical pass is generated from static validation or keyword matches.
